facts.fact: Adwave's minimum daily budget for pet grooming campaigns is $30 a day.
facts.quote: With Adwave, you can start from $30 a day with ads made from your website and add channels as your budget grows.

facts.fact: In Adwave, Reddit ads start at about $35 a day.
facts.quote: Reddit | Reaches local and pet-focused communities | From about $35/day

facts.fact: In Adwave, TikTok is opt-in, starts at about $91 a day, and requires a connected TikTok account.
facts.quote: TikTok | Short pet videos to a younger audience | Opt-in, from about $91/day, needs a connected TikTok account

facts.fact: The page states that running Adwave at the $30 daily minimum over 30 active days comes to $900.
facts.quote: Over 30 active days, that comes to $900.

facts.fact: Adwave charges $0.38 per image for extra campaign creative beyond what is included.
facts.quote: $0.38 per image

facts.fact: Adwave charges $6 per social video for extra campaign creative.
facts.quote: $6 per social video

facts.fact: Adwave charges $6 per 15-second TV spot for extra campaign creative.
facts.quote: $6 per 15-second TV spot

facts.fact: Adwave charges $12 per 30-second TV spot for extra campaign creative.
facts.quote: $12 per 30-second TV spot

facts.fact: Adwave card deposits carry a processing fee shown at checkout, while ACH deposits have no added fee.
facts.quote: Card deposits carry the processing fee shown at checkout, and ACH deposits have no added fee.

facts.fact: Adwave runs Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and Reddit ads on connected advertising accounts that Adwave owns, and sets up a Google Ads account for the workspace.
facts.quote: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and Reddit ads run on connected advertising accounts that Adwave owns, and Adwave sets up a Google Ads account for your workspace.

facts.fact: At the $30 minimum, TV, Google Search, Facebook and Instagram can run, while Reddit and TikTok need a higher budget or opt-in.
facts.quote: At $30 a day, TV, Google (including Search), Facebook and Instagram can all run.

facts.fact: Groomer to Groomer states that November and December are traditionally a very busy time for groomers, sometimes too busy.
facts.quote: notes that November and December are traditionally a very busy time for groomers, "sometimes too busy,"

facts.fact: Google Local Services Ads are pay-per-lead listings, and pre-badge listings can run during onboarding but appear below fully verified providers.
facts.quote: These are pay-per-lead listings that appear at the top of search results, and Google's own examples include pet grooming.

facts.fact: The example TV spot for a pet grooming ad is 15 seconds long.
facts.quote: A 15-second streaming TV spot shows the same transformation and names the shop and its neighborhood.

facts.fact: The example search ad headline for a grooming business is "First groom package, book online today."
facts.quote: with a headline such as, for example, First groom package, book online today.

facts.fact: Adwave says it builds a first draft of a campaign from the advertiser's website, and the advertiser can edit the creative or upload its own photos and finished ads before launch.
facts.quote: Adwave builds a first draft of this kind of campaign from your website. You can edit the creative, or upload your own photos and finished ads, before launch.

facts.fact: The page advises installing the tracking snippet on the booking confirmation page so that bookings count as conversions.
facts.quote: Install the tracking snippet on the booking confirmation page so bookings count as conversions.

facts.fact: According to the FTC's advertising guide for small business, online ads are held to the same standard as any other ad.
facts.quote: says online ads are held to the same standard as any other ad.

facts.fact: Under the FTC's endorsement guides, the endorser is liable for failing to disclose payment, and both the advertiser and the endorser can be liable for misleading claims.
facts.quote: both the advertiser and the endorser can be liable for misleading claims, and the endorser is liable for failing to disclose payment.

facts.fact: A claim that a medicated shampoo cures a skin problem is a health claim that needs proof.
facts.quote: Saying a medicated shampoo cures a skin problem is a health claim that needs proof.

facts.fact: Before launching an ad, the FTC suggests searching its website for past cases and guidance on claims similar to the advertiser's.
facts.quote: Before launching an ad, the FTC suggests searching its website for past cases and guidance on claims similar to yours.
